`data/metadata/`.

## Metadata Files in docs/metadata

```{r metadata-inventory, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(fs)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(knitr)

folder <- "data"
subfolder <- "meta"

# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g. data-dictionaries/)
# 1. List metadata files, including subdirectories (e.g., data-dictionaries/)
metadata_files <- dir_info(here(folder, subfolder), recurse = TRUE) %>%
  filter(type == "file") %>%
  mutate(
    file_name = path_file(path),
    ext = path_ext(path),
    # Subdirectory within docs/metadata
    folder = path_rel(path_dir(path), start = here(folder, subfolder)),
    # Replace "." (top-level) with "metadata"
    folder = if_else(folder == ".", "metadata", folder)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    size_kb = round(size / 1024, 1),
    size_display = if_else(size < 1024, "<1 KB", paste0(size_kb, " KB")) #,
    # Optional: custom folder order
    #   folder = factor(folder,
    #                   levels = c("data-dictionaries",
    #                              "descriptions",
    #                              "look-up-tables",
    #                              "metadata",
    #                              "raster-data-summaries",
    #                              "vector-data-summaries")
    #                  )
  ) %>%
  arrange(folder, file_name) %>%
  select(folder, file_name, ext, size_display) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(file_name, "^README\\."))

file_descriptions <- tribble(
  ~file_name, ~description,
  "U.S._Generalized_Soil_Map_Database_(STATSGO2).xml", "STATSGO2 xml data",
  "ecoregions_na_l1-l3_metadata_2021_xml.doc", "EPA Ecoregions Level I to III xml data",
  "nlcd_landcover_2020v2_30m_metadata_xml.docx", "NLCD xml data"
)

metadata_files <- left_join(metadata_files, file_descriptions, by = "file_name")


# 2. Render the table
metadata_files %>%
  select(Folder = folder,
         `File Name` = file_name,
         Extension = ext, Size = size_display,
         Description = description) %>%
  kable(align = "lcc")
```
